description: Ask ChatGPT about your xPlant tissue culture lab — look up your plants and explants, open lab tasks, contamination logs, media recipes, SOPs and SOP runs, transfer and stage history, lab rooms, devices and sensor readings; read the notes and comments on any record; see which photos are attached; look up a record by scanning its QR code; see what each culture line is priced at and how that price has changed; and review store sell-through, with units and revenue summarized per culture line and kept separate by currency. You can also let it write back at the bench: start a plant or explant, open a task, record a transfer, log a contamination event, add a note or a photo, draft a media recipe, run an SOP, or register a device and its readings. Reading and writing are separate permissions, granted one capability at a time — allowing xPlant to see your plants never lets it change them, and you can allow reading alone. Everything is scoped to the one lab you connect. Changes are attributed to your connected app in that lab's activity log, and it never predicts or guarantees plant, contamination, media, or sales outcomes.

defaultPrompt: How are the plants in my xPlant lab doing?
Which explants am I tracking right now?
What lab tasks are still open this week?
